form.label: Dell SonicWall Firewall Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage view for Dell SonicWall key=value firewall syslog records. Dashboard presence does not imply replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=dell:sonicwall host=$host_filter$ (action="*Denied*" OR msg="*Denied*") | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype=dell:sonicwall host=$host_filter$ (action="*Opened*" OR msg="*Opened*") | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype=dell:sonicwall host=$host_filter$ | stats dc(coalesce(dvc,fw,serial,sn,host)) as appliances
index=$index$ sourcetype=dell:sonicwall host=$host_filter$ | eval sonicwall_action=coalesce(action,msg,signature) | top limit=12 sonicwall_action

index=$index$ sourcetype=dell:sonicwall host=$host_filter$ | stats count values(action) as actions values(transport) as transports values(app) as apps values(dest_port) as dest_ports by src dest | sort - count | head 25

index=$index$ sourcetype=dell:sonicwall host=$host_filter$ (action="*Denied*" OR msg="*Denied*") | table _time host dvc serial src src_port dest dest_port transport app action signature signature_id marker _raw | sort - _time | head 50
index=$index$ sourcetype=dell:sonicwall host=$host_filter$ | table _time host dvc serial id m src src_port dest dest_port transport app action signature marker _raw | sort - _time | head 75

index=$index$ sourcetype=dell:sonicwall host=$host_filter$ | stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen dc(marker) as fixture_markers values(serial) as serials values(dvc) as appliances by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

chart.title: Protocol, application, and destination port coverage

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=dell:sonicwall host=$host_filter$ | eval protocol_app_port=coalesce(transport,"unknown") . " / " . coalesce(app,"unknown") . " / " . coalesce(dest_port,"unknown") | top limit=15 protocol_app_port

index=$index$ sourcetype=dell:sonicwall host=$host_filter$ | table _time index sourcetype source host vendor product dvc serial id m msg src src_port dest dest_port sport dport transport proto app action signature signature_id marker _raw | sort - _time | head 100

html.p: Scope and evidence boundary: This dashboard is limited to fixture-backed Dell SonicWall key=value firewall rows for connection-open and connection-denied smoke coverage. It does not prove full SonicWall firmware/event-category coverage, exact appliance timezone validation, collector health, or SC4S/Splunk replay/read-back validation.
